meta.summary: Hides Rutube's cookie bar and app link; blur or hide video previews and channel avatars; hide view counts, Shorts, carousel
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, rutube.ru home page (Russian interface). Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): cookie message 1 (a new rule was added because the original list does not know Rutube's `cookie-message-*` modules), side-menu app section 1, preview pictures 222, avatars 146, meta lines 202, Shorts row 1, home banner carousel 1. Selectors use `[class*="module-name__element"]` substrings of Rutube's CSS-module classes and one `aria-label` (Shorts); no Russian text is matched. Channel avatars blur at 6px, previews at 12px.

NOT verified: video pages (recommendation lists, comments), desktop layout, search and channel pages, signed-in states, the original ad rule, and how the CSS-module names change between Rutube releases.
